# Split the kitchen bill by who actually uses it.

> Free calculator for commissary/shared-kitchen operators: split pooled monthly costs (rent, utilities, trash, cleaning, pest control, insurance) fairly among multiple food-truck tenants by hours booked and storage used, instead of splitting evenly, and get an itemized bill for each tenant.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
